title: Exactness of the concrete left-coefficient Cech sequences
statement: Let $k$ be a field [def-weil-field], $f:X\to\operatorname{Spec}k$ and $g:Y\to\operatorname{Spec}k$ morphisms of quasi-compact schemes [def-pc-scheme] with affine diagonals. Let $S=(F_1\to F_2\to F_3)$ be a short exact sequence [def-weil-pbc-exact-sequence] of quasi-coherent $\mathcal O_X$-modules [pqf-def-coherent] and let $G$ be a quasi-coherent $\mathcal O_Y$-module. Choose the actual finite subcovers of the library affine covers, with open families $U$ on $X$ and $V$ on $Y$, and let $W_{ij}=\operatorname{pr}_1^{-1}U_i\cap\operatorname{pr}_2^{-1}V_j$ on $X\times_kY$. For a coefficient $F$, define $T(F)=\operatorname{Tot}(\check C(U,F)_k^{\mathrm{ext}}\otimes_k\check C(V,G)_k^{\mathrm{ext}})$, where scalar restriction is along the structure map and superscript ext means extension from natural to integer degrees by zero. Define $P(F)=\check C(W,\operatorname{pr}_1^*F\otimes\operatorname{pr}_2^*G)_k^{\mathrm{ext}}$, with the external coefficient convention of [lem-sc-picard-external-cup-cochain]. Both constructions are functors in $F$, using coefficient maps on sections, signed tensor total maps, pullback and tensor maps. The two short complexes $T(S)$ and $P(S)$ are short exact. This asserts neither a cup comparison nor a cohomology isomorphism.

proof.text: The library finite subcovers are finite affine covers. Affine diagonal makes all nonempty finite intersections affine. On each intersection apply the sectionwise kernel property and the affine quasi-coherent cokernel formula to S. Restriction of scalars preserves the resulting short exact module sequence.

Tensor each section sequence with the section spaces of G over the field. It stays short exact. Finite tuple products preserve this exactness; in each natural total degree there are finitely many nonzero factor degrees. Direct sums of these sequences are exact, so the tensor total sequence is degreewise short exact.

On intersections of W, use the affine product spectrum, affine pullback section isomorphisms and tensor section formula. These identify the product-coefficient sequence with the factor section sequence tensored with sections of G. Quasi-coherence of pullbacks, identified with tensorPullback by the adjunction, and tensor-product quasi-coherence justify all the section comparisons.

Products over tuples and extension by zero preserve the degreewise short exact sequences; in a category of cochain complexes degreewise exactness, monicity and epicity give short exactness. The actual functor constructions preserve zero: scalar Cech by product projections, tensor total by summand inclusions, pullback by its additive adjunction, and tensor by the tensor-Hom adjunction. Empty covers give zero terms. These are direct applications of the corresponding Mathlib constructions.
